children: Cronos is set to publish its app product roadmap together with part 1 of a tokenomics proposal, alongside the Cronos network strategy and the Cronos Labs development strategy. The release consolidates several planning documents into one update, giving holders a single reference for how the team intends to develop the app layer, the chain, and the token economy. The tokenomics paper is the component most likely to draw scrutiny, since it addresses supply and utility questions directly.

For CRO holders, the tokenomics proposal is the direct catalyst in this update. Its contents will define how supply, issuance, and token utility are framed going forward, and holders can evaluate those parameters once the text is available. Because this is part 1, the proposal may be extended or revised in later installments, so conclusions drawn from it should account for that partial scope. The accompanying roadmap and network strategy provide context on which products and development priorities the token economics are meant to support.
Sep 14th we will roll out product roadmap for the app, part 1 of a tokenomics proposal,
strategy, Cronos Labs dev strategy overall.
